proof_body:
by
  intro m _ _ A
  have h1 : Commute A (-A) := (Commute.refl A).neg_right
  have h2 := Matrix.exp_add_of_commute A (-A) h1
  have h3 := Matrix.exp_add_of_commute (-A) A h1.symm
  rw [add_neg_cancel, NormedSpace.exp_zero] at h2
  rw [neg_add_cancel, NormedSpace.exp_zero] at h3
  exact ⟨h2.symm, h3.symm⟩
target_source: ∀ (m : Type*) [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m m ℝ), NormedSpace.exp A * NormedSpace.exp (-A) = 1 ∧ NormedSpace.exp (-A) * NormedSpace.exp A = 1
